headline: Consulting in financial services and technology.
lede: I advise companies and investors on strategy, acquisitions, product development, and technology delivery. My work has included payments modernization, the sale of a digital banking business, and helping a San Francisco startup raise capital and build its product.
intro: Most engagements start with a question that has money, time or reputation attached to it. Should we bring this platform in-house or re-contract? Is this business worth more to us or to someone else? What would it take to ship this, and who do we need? I do the analysis, build the case, and stay through delivery.

services.title: Strategy and investment decisions
services.summary: Business cases, build-versus-buy and vendor decisions, operating models, and the materials an executive team or board needs to decide.

example.label: A global bank's real-time payments decision

services.title: Mergers, acquisitions and divestitures
services.summary: Options assessments, commercial and product due diligence, carve-outs and transition planning, and post-merger integration.

example.label: The sale of Central 1's digital banking business

services.title: Ventures, startups and advisory
services.summary: Fundraising materials and models, product strategy and go-to-market, and advisory roles for founders and investors.

services.title: Program delivery
services.summary: Program design and governance, delivery models and team design, estimation and resourcing, and vendor management.

example.label: A pod-based delivery model for a payments program

how.headline: From a conversation to a full program.
how.text: Engagements scale to the problem. Some need one person for two weeks, and some need a team for a year.

steps.title: A conversation
steps.text: Thirty minutes, no charge. Tell me the problem and I'll tell you honestly whether I'm the right person and what it would take.

steps.title: A focused engagement
steps.text: Two to eight weeks for a decision memo, a business case, a diligence read or an options assessment. One senior person, direct access, a clear answer.

steps.title: A program
steps.text: Months, not weeks, from strategy through delivery, with a team sized to the work. Design, engineering, data and change management alongside the strategy.

partner.name: Electric Mind
partner.headline: Working with Electric Mind
text: For larger work I draw on partnerships with firms like Electric Mind, a Toronto consulting and engineering firm I work with. Electric Mind describes itself as a forward-deployed AI firm: strategists, designers and engineers who take a problem from strategy through to systems running in production, with deep experience in financial services.

That lets me scale from one person to a full delivery team without changing the way we work together. A small engagement can grow into a complex one without a handoff, and a complex one can start with a single conversation.
partner._review: Service names are taken from electricmind.com's practice areas (Strategy / Design / Engineering) as of Oct 26 2026. Run the whole block by the Electric Mind lead before publishing.

work.text: Business case, target solution and program design to move real-time peer-to-peer payments from a vendor-hosted service in-house: the economics against 10%+ annual growth, the gap analysis between requirements and solution design, a four-pod delivery model, and the governance behind the executive decision.

Business case and multi-year roadmap to modernize payment-rail access across e-Transfer, wires, AFTs, bill payments, cheques, fraud and AML. Earlier, assessed modernization, partnership and sale options for the Forge digital-banking business, led due diligence, and oversaw the carve-out and sale to Intellect Design.

Product foundation for Atelio, FIS's embedded-finance platform: client personas, prioritized fintech experiences, product vision, competitive analysis, MVP scope and go-to-market plans with Sales, Marketing and Support.

work.role: Chief of staff; product manager; strategic advisor
work.text: Joined a San Francisco B2B fintech pre-seed and helped scale it through Series A: investor materials and models behind more than US$25 million raised, on- and offshore engineering teams shipping a logistics and marketing platform, and the company's KPIs and roadmap. Returned in 2025 to advise the CEO on the Series B.

Post-merger integration of an acquired fintech product for a tier-one technology provider, delivered with a zero-defect cut-over. API and microservice design for a new consumer-banking platform. Led a 14-person team launching a Canadian bank's digital platform on time and on budget.
